jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Emi Labs we are on a mission to increase Frontline Workers’ access to professional opportunities. 
 
This is a 2.7 billion population that accounts for 80% of the world’s workforce. They are digitally invisible, as there’s little to no data available on who they are, their career history, or their skill set, limiting their access to professional opportunities and growth. We're here to transform this by building the infrastructure to make Frontline Workers visible. 
 
Our first step to achieving our mission is to transform the recruiting experience into an easy, human and fair process, for both candidates and companies with high-volume job openings. 
Emi, our main product, is an A.I. recruitment assistant that enables companies to engage in a conversation with each applicant to detect interested and qualified individuals while saving Recruiters a huge amount of time by automating tasks such as screening, validating skills, scheduling interviews, and collecting documents. 
 
We were part of Y-Combinator's Winter 2019 batch and in 2022 we have raised an $11M funding round co-led by Merus Capital and Khosla Ventures.


About the Product Team
 
The Product Team at Emi helps translate a company strategy into a product strategy, and then execute on that strategy over time. We plan quarterly roadmaps of new product development, lead the development of those new features, and also ensure our existing Product is delivering the expected product outcomes. Talking to users and analyzing data are some of our most important tools. Product development at Emi is an extremely collaborative effort between Product, Engineering, Data Science, and customer-facing teams.
 
What you'll be doing
 
You will become one of the few Product Managers at Emi Labs, drive a huge amount of impact by building and improving our Product, and grow within a high-growth company. You will be defining product strategy, developing product requirements, and overseeing execution for some of the highest priority initiatives that will build the next generation infrastructure for Frontline Workers worldwide. 
 
This role will provide you the opportunity to develop the strategy for several of Emi Lab's core Solutions, and get feedback on your plans directly from Emi’s leadership team. We’re looking for curious and high-energy product thinkers & leaders who can develop and grow the product Emi Labs needs to achieve its mission.
 

Task & Activities
- Define our product strategy for several of our core solutions.

- Develop requirements to build new products on our Roadmap.

- Lead cross-functional teams to execute high-impact product initiatives.

- Optimize existing features to drive product success for our Customers.

- Make thoughtful trade-offs among a diverse set of teams and priorities.

- Continually perform user research to collect insights on our user experience and value proposition.

- Own product KPIs and perform impact evaluations on the initiatives you lead.
What we are looking for
- At least 5 years of Product Management experience, managing technical software products from kick-off to ship.

- Experience leading products that require coordination of many stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

- Persistence and a whatever-it-takes approach to ensure that your product and team are successful.

- Extreme curiosity, a bias for action, and appetite for learning and growth.

- Creative problem solving: thinks big, starts small, grows fast.

- Data-driven and rational approach to making decisions.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, both in Spanish and English.

- Empathy and a willingness to help others across the company.

- Ability to work in a high-growth environment and adapt to changing scenarios and uncertainty.
Bonus
- Product Management experience on a B2B SaaS Product.

- Experience in starting a company/product from scratch.

- Some coding experience (we use SQL, javascript and python).
What we offer
- 💰 Competitive salary: Salaries paid in USD.

- 📈 Stock Options: Stock Options Package as part of your compensation package.

- 🧑🏽‍💻 Flexible remote-first work culture. We work towards goals*.

- 🏖️ Vacations: 3 weeks of vacation.

- 🧑‍🎄 Holiday season: Week off between Christmas and New Year's Eve.

- 💆 Physical Wellness program: We have partnered up with Gympass, a well-being platform that offers the best coverage of top gyms, studios, and activities for you to choose from.

- 🇺🇸 English Classes: Improve your English skills with our in-company teachers.

- 📚 Internal library: Get all the free books - digital, physical - you like, anytime.
Emi Labs is committed to fostering a fair, inclusive, and equal work environment. We believe diversity is crucial to building the best team and solving Frontline Worker's access to professional opportunities, that is why Emi aims to be a leader in workplace equality and move both our company and the industry forward.
 
Emi is a very dynamic and new startup where growth opportunities are there for the taking! We are just building a team with great impact so now is the best time to jump aboard!
